title: snap-coverage-rollup-lite-2026-11-03
body:
Purpose: quick, one-off rollup to identify small coverage gaps for weekend surge + APAC overlap. Lightweight spreadsheet — use for fast handoffs.

Sprint window: 2026-11-01 -> 2026-11-07 (weekend focus)
Prepared by: Maya Chen (product-ops) — raw notes, not formal runbook.

HEADERS: Area | Team owner | Primary on-call | Est daily serving requests (k reqs) | Estimated token churn (k tokens/day) | Current coverage (%) | Gap magnitude (small/med/large) | Blocking risk | Quick remedial action (owner)

Rows:
hosted-api | Alex Kim | SRE-A | 42 | 1,120 | 96 | small | low (burstable) | tune autoscale windows (Alex)
dedicated (EU) | Priya Sharma | Infra-B | 8 | 210 | 88 | med | med (capacity commit) | reassign 1x burst node this weekend (Infra-B)
private (APAC pilot) | Noor Ahmed | SE-APAC | 2.1 | 56 | 62 | large | high (region mismatch + config drift) | manual fallback routing to hosted (Noor + Ops)
serving-runtime - kv/cache | Jordan Patel | Runtime-1 | 0.5 | 35 | 80 | small | med (lime latency spikes) | clear stale KV cache on nodes pre-weekend (Jordan)
observability / traces | Mei Tan | Obs-2 | - | - | 70 | med | med (gap in token-level tracing for certain routes) | enable short retention debug window for affected routes (Mei)
solutions-eng (SE pilot) | Luis Garcia | SE-P | 1.2 | 33 | 92 | small | low | brief SE > infra sync to confirm deploy (Luis)
platform-engineering - routing | Priya Sharma | Plat-1 | - | - | 78 | med | high (APAC routing weight wrong) | adjust regional weights + smoke test (Priya)

Quick calcs (very rough):
- APAC private pilot user requests this weekend ~2.1k reqs -> token churn ~56k/day -> coverage at 62% implies ~21k tokens/day uncovered (approx).
- If fallback to hosted used for uncovered volume, estimated incremental hosted cost ~0.6x baseline (quick econ needed).

Top quick risks (ranked):
1) Private APAC routing/config drift (Noor + Priya) — high risk for weekend e2e failure.
2) Dedicated EU burst shortfall — medium risk if enterprise load spikes.
3) Observability blindspot on certain LLM routes — blocking for debug if incident occurs.

Immediate ask list (owners):
- Noor Ahmed: validate APAC private routing table + confirm KMS access for fallback by 2026-11-04 EOD. (JIRA: ENG-4312)
- Priya Sharma: provision one reserved burst node in EU Dedicated pool for 2026-11-06 -> 2026-11-08 and update capacity note in console (ticket: INF-2201).
- Alex Kim / SRE: pre-warm autoscale policy changes (low risk) and monitor 5m for scaling anomalies (Slack: #ops-coverage).
- Mei Tan: open 24h retention debug window for routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat for 2026-11-06 -> 2026-11-07.
- Jordan Patel: schedule a cache-clear job with rollout at 03:00 UTC on 2026-11-06 with rollback notes.

Notes to self / loose threads:
- Need quick econ calc from finance: cost delta if hosted handles fallback traffic (Priya to loop Finance via FIN-ops).
- Confirm legal that APAC pilot data path OK for temporary hosted fallback — flagged to Security (sec-ops).
- Consider quick canary on hosted for the APAC pilot (low perc traffic) prior to full fallback.

Short-term decisions (proposed):
- If private APAC <70% coverage by 2026-11-05 18:00 UTC -> enable hosted fallback with 10% initial traffic, monitor quality, escalate after 30m. (Owner: Noor)
- Prioritize dedicated EU burst node provision if committed load forecast >10k reqs/day (Owner: Priya).

Open questions (needs answer in 24h):
- Who owns regional key rotation impact for KMS in private? (CC: Security)
- Do we have pre-approved cost envelope for weekend burst? (Finance)

Attachments / quick refs:
- Linked Linear ticket for APAC fallback plan: https://linear.app/PROD/issue/PRD-1123-coverage-gap
- Runtime PR that touched KV eviction heuristics: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtimes/pull/459
- Slack thread: #ops-coverage ts=1720304000 (initial debug notes)

Status / next update cadence:
- I will update this sheet with hard confirmations as owners reply. Plan: final short rollup at 2026-11-05 20:00 UTC.

Quick retrospective note (post-weekend): capture what we toggled and costs — add to product-ops / ad-hoc archive (one-pager).

End of quickscan. Keep this doc lean; if action grows, spin up a tracker with per-step owners/timestamps.
